summary: Apply AI methods to crop planning, grading and postharvest decisions. Review practical use cases and plan a focused agribusiness pilot.
lede: Applied AI for agribusiness operations helps teams assess data and identify useful applications across farm-to-market decisions. For operations managers, farm planners and supply-chain analysts, the course builds skills in mapping data readiness, reviewing NDVI and model outputs, and assigning human checks for input planning, harvest grading, postharvest handling and demand forecasting while weighing operational constraints.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who make or support decisions across farm production, postharvest handling and agribusiness distribution. It is designed for people who want to scope AI applications against real workflows, available data and operating constraints.
modules: NIST AI RMF for Agribusiness Controls
Excel Pilot Scorecard and Decision Reporting
prerequisites: Working knowledge of agribusiness operations and routine spreadsheet use is expected. No coding or programming is required. Access to Excel or equivalent spreadsheet software supports the course exercises.
